_comment: NAI V4.5 Full txt2img — 对照官网默认配置 (832x1216 Normal Portrait, 28 steps, CFG 5, Euler+Karras)。前提: ComfyUI 已安装 bedovyy/ComfyUI_NAIDGenerator 节点包且 ComfyUI 根目录 .env 中已配置 NAI_ACCESS_TOKEN。
_format_warning: 本文件为 ComfyUI API Format (节点ID为key的dict)，**不支持直接拖入画布**。仅作为参数参考。要在 ComfyUI 中使用，请按 _setup_steps 手动搭建 3 个节点。
_setup_steps: 1. 在 ComfyUI 画布右键 -> Add Node -> NovelAI -> ModelOption ✒️🅝🅐🅘
2. 右键 -> Add Node -> NovelAI -> Generate ✒️🅝🅐🅘
3. 右键 -> Add Node -> Image -> SaveImage
4. 连线: ModelOption.NAID_OPTION (输出) -> Generate.option (输入)
5. 连线: Generate.IMAGE (输出) -> SaveImage.images (输入)
6. 按下方 1/2/3 节点的 inputs 字段照抄参数到对应控件
7. Queue Prompt 出图。生成结果自动存到 ComfyUI/output/NAI_autosave/

_official_mapping.Model: node 1 ModelOptionNAID.model -> 官网 'Model' 下拉
_official_mapping.Image Size: node 2 width/height -> 官网 'Image Size' Normal Portrait = 832x1216
_official_mapping.Steps: node 2 steps -> 官网 'Steps' (Anlas-free 上限 28)
_official_mapping.Prompt Guidance Rescale: node 2 cfg_rescale -> 官网同名滑块
_official_mapping.Noise Schedule: node 2 scheduler -> 官网 'Noise Schedule' karras=Karras
_official_mapping.Variety+: node 2 variety -> 官网 'Variety+' 开关
_official_mapping.Decrisper: node 2 decrisper -> 官网 'Decrisper' 开关
_official_mapping.SMEA: node 2 smea -> 官网仅 V3 有效, V4/V4.5 应保持 none
_official_mapping.Uncondition Scale: node 2 uncond_scale -> 官网 'Negative Prompt Strength' (默认1.0)
_official_mapping.Anlas Free 限制: node 2 limit_opus_free=false -> 关闭则按实际 Anlas 扣费; true 则强制小图免费档

inputs.positive: 1girl, solo, looking at viewer, white shirt, classroom, best quality, amazing quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
inputs.negative: lowres, worst quality, bad anatomy, bad hands, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, blurry
